title: How Many Are in This Image? A Safety Evaluation Benchmark for Vision LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the attack success rate (ASR) of visual adversarial examples designed to jailbreak models into completing derogatory and toxic sentences targeting specific genders.
Evaluating the attack success rate (ASR) of visual adversarial examples designed to jailbreak models into completing derogatory and toxic sentences targeting specific races.

Using counterfactual question variants in Visual Question Answering (VQA) to measure the models' over-reliance on textual instructions (language bias) over actual visual content, assessing performance drops when textual prompts contradict the image.
